full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana J. State has filed this criminal petition for leave to appeal challenging the order of the High Court Division passed in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.34188 of 2010 granting hail of the accused respondent Maruf Raihan in Shahbag Police Station Case No.14 dated 07.09.2010 corresponding to G.R. No.537 of 2010 under Section 57(2) of the তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি আইন, ২০০৬ pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka. 

 2. The above case was started on an FIR. filed by Md. Shahjahan, a sub-Inspector of police with Shahbag Thana against this petitioner on the allegation that on 25.08.2010 at about 11.28 a.m. an e-mail was received at the e-mail address of the Ministry of Information and Communication Technology from the e-mail address rabeyafishltd@ gmail.com. In that F. I. R. the said e-mail was quoted which was as under:- 

 4. A bail petition was moved on behalf of the accused respondent before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka which was rejected and thereafter the above stated Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 34188 of 2010 was filed before the High Court Division praying for bail of the accused-respondent. Rule was issued in that Criminal Miscellaneous Case and subsequently by the impugned judgment and order dated 24.04.2011 the High Court Division made that rule absolute granting bail to the accused respondent. 

 6. It appears that the High Court Division granted bail to the accused respondent making observations to the effect that no transcript of the alleged e-mali was incorporated with the F.I.R. and that nothing conclusive or tangible prima facie evidence was available at this stage to show that the said e-mail was received from the petitioner's address. The High Court Division, however, took into consideration the accused respondent's jail custody for about seven months also in granting bail to him. However, it has been submitted before us by the learned Deputy Attorney General for the State that in the meantime the investigation of the case has been completed and many tangible evidence have been gathered showing involvement of this accused-respondent in sending the e-mail in question. 

 7. The learned Advocate for the accused-respondent did not deny the submission of the learned Deputy Attorney General that the investigation of this case has been concluded in the meantime.
